title: dendrosenecio adnivalis subsp. friesiorum

It is native to the high-altitude regions of Mount Kenya and is a subspecies of the giant mountain senecio. The health benefits of Dendrosenecio adnivalis subsp. friesiorum include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation.
